445034.overview:
The year is 2017. While EM vehicles have been available to the wealthy for decades, a “misplaced” shipment of military-grade EMV components has fallen into the hands of the speed gangs of San Angeles.

A new era of racing has dawned.

Strap yourself into the cockpit of a futuristic racing machine and step on the boost! Elevated Speed takes you to the neon-lit future of 2017 to prove yourself to be the fastest EMV driver on Earth… and beyond!
